PROGRAM ScanOrder
VAR ButtonSeen : BOOL := FALSE; END_VAR
VAR_INPUT StartButton AT %I0.0 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Lamp AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; END_VAR
ButtonSeen := StartButton;
Lamp := ButtonSeen;
END_PROGRAM
